                                                        				 hips up and toes curled under.

कौौशल सीीखनेे केे चरण (Phases of Skill Learning)
उद्देेश्य: इस पााठ केे अंंत मेंं आप यह जाान सकेंंगेे:
• कौौशल हस्तांं�तरण कीी साात-चरणीीय वि�धि� काा वि�श्लेेषण करनाा

Trade     :                                                                                       Semester               :


Week No :                                            Skill No :                                   Time Required :

Title     :

Objectives: At the end of this demonstration, the trainee shall be able to:
 •   Test engine compression in different stages.

Tools, Equipments and Materials Required:

 1 A petrol vehicle in running condition
 2 Compression gauge with necessary adapters
 3 Spark plug spanner
 4 Engine oil in an oil can
 5 Trainees’ tool kit



                                                                                                              D
Procedure:		

     Introduction
                                                                                                          H E
                                                                                                         S
                        The engine’s compression is tested using the compression gauge. The results from the

                                          I                                                           LI
                        compression gauge at different stages indicate the condition of the engine, which helps


                                         M B
                                       I
                        determine if the engine requires reconditioning.

       Install
     Compression
       Gauge
                                     N
                                  © EPU
                          1 Place the vehicle on a level ground.
                          2 Apply the hand brake.


                                      R
                          3 Switch off the ignition.


                                    E
                          4 Open the bonnet.


                                  B
                          5 Remove the air filter assembly.


                                O
                          6 Remove the ignition coil assembly from all the cylinders.



                    T T   7 Remove the spark plug from all the cylinders.




        NO
                          8 Select the correct size adapter and fit it with the compression gauge.
                          9 Install the compression gauge in the 1st cylinder’s spark plug hole.
                          10 Hold it properly to take readings.
                          11 Press the accelerator pedal fully and crank the engine for a few seconds.
                          12 Observe the readings and allow the engine to crank until the needle on the compression
                             gauge stalls.
                          13 Stop cranking the engine.
                          14 Note down the maximum reading obtained.
                          15 The reading obtained during dry test is __________ kg/cm2.
                          16 Remove the compression gauge.
                          17 Put a few drops of engine oil through the spark plug hole.
                          18 Install the compression gauge again.
                          19 Crank the engine and note down the readings.
                          20 The reading obtained during the wet test is __________ kg/cm2.
                          21 Repeat the procedure for all cylinders.

                                                                                          INFORMATION SHEET
लि�खि�त अनुुदेेशाात्मक साामग्रीी


                                    Trade     : Machine Shop Group                                                                               Module : Basic Turner

                                    Lesson    : The Lathe Bed                                                                                    Time    : 1 Hour


                                    Objectives: At the end of this lesson, the trainees shall be able to:

                                     1 State the importance of the lathe bed
                                     2 Name the types of lathe beds
                                     3 Differentiate the merits and demerits of each.

                                     The lathe bed is one of the most important parts of the lathe and it serves two purposes. (i) It holds the fixed
                                     units of the lathe in perfect alignment and (ii) It provides ways on which the sliding units can be operated.
                                     The bed is generally made of close - grained grey cast iron. The reasons are:
                                     1 This metal is easy to machine.
                                     2 It flows easily to occupy the complicated parts of the mould in its molten stage.
                                     3 Under load, it may break but does not bend.




                                                                                                                                                         D
                                     The lathe bed may have bed shears machined (i) Flat, (ii) Inverted ‘vee’, and (iii) a combination of “flat” and


                                                                                                                                                       E
                                     “vee”.

                                     Accordingly, the bed is known as flat bed, “V” bed, and combination bed.

                                                                                    I                                                               SH
                                                                                 I M B                                                           LI
                                     The flat bed is generally provided for lathes meant for heavy - duty work, while ‘V’ bed ways are provided on


                                                                               N
                                     lathes meant for precision work. The combination bed is used in lathes for general - purpose work.



                                                                            © EPU
                                     The lathe bed is generally rough - machined and is kept in the open air for several months for “aging” or seasoning
                                     so that it undergoes all possible changes due to climatic variations.



                                                                              E R
                                     The front and rear ways are rigidly supported by cross webs. The lathe bed is carried on legs, the height of


                                                                            B
                                     which depends on the size of the lathe. The legs are made hollow castings to accommodate the coolant motor,
                                     main motor, the portion may be removed. After the work is completed, it can be reassembled. This is known
                                     as the gap bed.

                                                          T               O
                                                        T
                                     A detachable portion of the bed is fitted at the headstock end. When turning large diameter and short - length



                                            NO
                                     work, the portion may be removed. After the work is completed, it can be reassembled. This is known as the
                                     gap bed.

                                     Assignment:

                                     1 What are the two purposes of the lathe bed?

                                     2 Name the material out of which the lathe bed is made?

                                     3 Give four reasons for the choice of this material?
